notes: §1985:X.2.5.4 GR4: after an outermost program's end program header the next COBOL statement 'must be the Identification Division header of a program to be compiled separately'. The grammar's compilationGroup admits only a further source unit after endProgramHeader (a stray DISPLAY is COBOL0001 'unexpected DISPLAY'), and at 85 VersionConformancePass refuses each 2002 looseness with COBOL0900: VisitIdentificationDivision a unit starting at PROGRAM-ID without the header, VisitFunctionIdParagraph a FUNCTION-ID unit, VisitClassDefinition a CLASS-ID unit. Probes (class b/c): header-less PROGRAM-ID SUBPGM, FUNCTION-ID, CLASS-ID and a stray statement after END PROGRAM each refused at 85; the witness (two separately compiled programs, MAIN START/IN SUBPGM/MAIN END) runs.

next.reason: 1985: after an outermost program's end program header, the next COBOL statement 'must be the Identification Division header of a program to be compiled separately'. §2023:10.6.1 makes a compilation group 'zero or more source units in any mix' of program-prototype, function-prototype, program-, function-, class- and interface-definitions, each with an optional IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header; §2023:10.6.2 SR1 limits the order: 'function-prototypes and program-prototypes shall precede all other types of source units'. Looser: what follows may be a function, class or interface definition, or start at PROGRAM-ID without the header. Every conforming 1985 program means the same.
